entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco de Moncada, 3rd Marquis of Aytona, (1586–1635) was a Spanish diplomat, soldier and writer of the early 17th century. He was Ambassador in the Holy Roman Empire and interim Governor of the Spanish Netherlands, a general and commander of the Spanish-Flemish armies.
